name: Effect Datastar TypeScript prototype capability loop

description: Baseline before implementing ts-star prototype; research plan and benchmark script only

asi.hypothesis: Establish a zero-capability baseline and commit the autoresearch harness before adding the first vertical slice.
asi.study_summary: Datastar favors backend-owned state, SSE element/signal patches, fat morphs, sparse signals; strongest borrowed ideas are Stario small SSE helpers, StarHTML typed expression DSL, Hyperlith explicit CQRS/fat morph, Falco typed helpers.

description: First vertical slice attempt failed one HTML expectation around false reactive attr rendering

asi.hypothesis: Add the minimal Datastar SSE, HTML, typed signal/action, Effect signal decoding, and counter handler slice.
asi.error_details: Vitest had 17/18 passing; only html-datastar counter render expected data-attr:disabled=false to be omitted, but renderer correctly treats string attribute value "false" as present because Datastar expressions are strings.
asi.rollback_reason: Failed test run; per autoresearch rules crash logs and reverts the attempted slice.
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply the slice with the test expectation fixed or remove the dataAttr('disabled', false) from the view. Prefer not emitting the false expression in this fixture because reactive attributes intentionally use string expressions.

description: Implement minimal vertical slice: Datastar SSE encoding, typed signal/action HTML helpers, Effect Schema signal decoding, and counter handler

asi.hypothesis: A small pure core plus Effect Schema request decoding can prove the framework shape without committing to JSX, routers, or CQRS machinery.
asi.learned: The minimal slice is coherent: golden-like SSE strings, typed signal refs, HTML rendering, Web Request signal parsing, and Effect handlers all compose in tests. Reactive data-* expression values are strings even when the expression is false; omit attrs only for HTML boolean false, not Datastar expression strings.
architecture_validated: pure sse.ts wire encoder is easy to golden-test
datastar.ts expression/attribute helpers provide type safety without much ceremony
request.ts can decode GET query and POST body signals with Effect Schema
vertical counter handler can stay a plain Effect returning a Web Response
asi.next_action_hint: Add a stronger compile-time type-safety test for signal value operations, plus exact comparisons against more included SDK fixtures such as namespace/multiline signal and remove signal cases.
